relevance.rationale: QOU's rem:knot-complement-group introduces representations rho: pi_1(S^3 \ K) -> PSL(2,C) and asserts that 'the image of rho characterises the geometric structure on the knot complement' — an informal claim with no source. prop:thurston-volume-additivity computes volume by summing over an ideal triangulation, and the mass pipeline repeatedly invokes Mostow rigidity to argue the volume (hence the mass) is discrete. Francaviglia proves the rigorous cusped-manifold versions of all three: vol(rho) is well-defined for any representation, is computed by straightening any ideal triangulation, is bounded by the relative simplicial volume, and — the rigidity theorem — equals vol(M) only for the discrete faithful rho. It is background/technique that upgrades informal claims to sourced ones, not a result any QOU derivation currently needs: QOU works with the geometric representation only, where classical Thurston/Mostow already suffice.

keyResults.statement: For a cusped orientable 3-manifold M and any rho: pi_1(M) -> Isom^+(H^3), all pseudo-developing maps give the same volume (so vol(rho) is well-defined), and vol(rho) equals the straightened volume — i.e. it can be computed by straightening ANY ideal triangulation of M and summing tetrahedron volumes.
keyResults.useForFolio: prop:thurston-volume-additivity asserts triangulation-independent additivity of volume over an ideal triangulation; Thm 4.10 is the theorem that licenses 'any triangulation' in the cusped, representation-valued setting rather than only for the complete structure.

keyResults.statement: |vol(rho)| < v_3 * ||(M, dM)|| for every representation, where v_3 is the regular ideal tetrahedron volume and ||(M, dM)|| the relative simplicial (Gromov) volume.
keyResults.useForFolio: atom-knot-mass-derivation-proof invokes Gromov's norm theorem alongside Mostow in the 'post-Archimedean naming' step; Thm 5.1 is the sharp representation-level inequality in that pairing and is a citable bound on how large a non-geometric representation's volume can be.

keyResults.statement: If M is hyperbolic and vol(rho) = vol(M), then rho is discrete and faithful.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is the precise form of rem:knot-complement-group's unsourced claim that 'the image of rho characterises the geometric structure': volume maximality singles out the geometric representation. Also the sharp statement behind the corpus's repeated 'Mostow rigidity locks the volume' framing.

proposedActions.rationale: rem:knot-complement-group makes an unsourced claim ('the image of rho characterises the geometric structure') that the rigidity theorem states precisely.
prop:thurston-volume-additivity's triangulation-independence in the cusped case is Thm 4.9/4.10.
